Stock Market Outlook 2026: Political Risks Loom | Morgan Stanley
Top 10 geopolitical developments in 2026 | EY - Global

summary: Middle East conflict (U.S.-Iran) is primary driver — oil surged on May 4 (WTI ~$106+). UAE intercepting Iranian missiles. S&P fell 0.41% on May 4 before rebounding May 5. Other flashpoints: U.S. activity in Venezuela, NATO posture in Greenland. Tariff uncertainty and U.S. midterm elections also weighing on outlook. Consumer staples and utilities outperforming; energy stocks boosted.
